## Green on the PC: the full desktop layout
With Green on (Themes +) and a window at least 900 px wide, Streyn now has the three-panel desktop layout of the big music apps, in the same sizes. Phones keep their Green layout.

- **Top bar:** … menu with File, Edit, View, Playback and Help, back and forward, a round Home button, the search field with **Browse** on the right, What's New, Friend Activity and your profile. It also shows in the browser now, not only in the desktop app
- **Your Library on the left:** Liked songs, playlists, saved albums, your yearly top songs and followed artists with covers, filter chips (Playlists, Albums, Artists), a play button over the cover on hover. The library icon folds it to a 72 px strip of covers and back, **+ Create** opens a menu for a new playlist, import, upload or your mix
- **Now playing panel on the right:** cover, title, share and save, a lyrics preview in the colour of the cover that moves with the song, About the artist with picture, listeners and Follow, credits with Follow, and the next song in the queue. The expand button opens the big player
- **Queue and devices in the panel:** the queue button shows the queue (now playing, next from, clear queue) and Recently played; the device button shows Connect to a device. When the music plays on another device, a green bar under the player says where
- **Miniplayer:** the button next to the volume opens a small window with the cover (always on top where the browser allows it, otherwise a floating card). Hover for the controls; its … opens the Miniplayer settings with Background colour, Queue and Done
- **Pages:** playlist and album heads in the colour of the cover over the full width, the title in the largest size that fits, a song table with #, Title, Album and duration columns and a header line that sticks when you scroll. Artists get a big picture with the name on it. When the head scrolls away, a bar with the green play button and the name stays at the top
- **Small things:** tooltips like the big apps, full screen button, zoom with Ctrl + plus, minus and 0, the same animations for menus, panels and folding the library
- **Font:** Green uses Figtree, a free font close to Spotify's own one. Only in Green
- Updated: docs (Green on the PC) and the Green picture on the website

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** nothing changes on the phone layout
- **Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the desktop app picks it up from the server
